headline_marked: [[Claude wins]] AI website build test, beating Gemini & ChatGPT
headline: Claude wins AI website build test, beating Gemini & ChatGPT
summary: An AI model comparison reveals Claude's superior reasoning and design capabilities, though it takes significantly longer to complete tasks.
details: A recent test tasked Gemini, ChatGPT, and Claude with building a used car dealership website. While all models successfully generated a working site, Claude demonstrated superior reasoning and design, producing more realistic listings and a polished aesthetic.

Gemini's output, though initially promising, contained significant flaws. It randomly assigned images to vehicle listings, including a Ferrari for a Ford F-150, and priced disparate vehicles almost identically, indicating a lack of nuanced reasoning.

ChatGPT performed better than Gemini with image selection, at least matching vehicle types, and offered a more polished design than Gemini. However, it still pulled random internet images and lacked the contextual accuracy seen in Claude's results.

Claude excelled by generating accurate images that matched the listed vehicles, including realistic condition badges and high-resolution photos. Its website design was also described as more mature and polished compared to the other models.

A key trade-off for Claude's superior output was its speed. While Gemini and ChatGPT completed the task in under two minutes, Claude took approximately 10 minutes, primarily due to its effort in finding and incorporating realistic images.

Despite the longer processing time, the author found Claude's results to be worth the wait, highlighting its ability to understand and execute the underlying intent of the prompt, even when not explicitly detailed.
